summary: Recursion Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K on September 21, 2026, disclosing a September 15, 2026 amendment to its November 3, 2023 Master Agreement with Tempus AI plus a new RNA Foundation Model License Agreement. Recursion extended the term from five to six years, eliminated its termination-for-convenience right, reset annual license fees to $14,000,000 for years three through five, with at least $4,000,000 cash and the remainder payable in cash, Class A stock, or a combination, and reduced accessible de-identified records. Tempus received a two-year, non-exclusive, non-sublicensable, non-transferable, worldwide TxFM license limited to oncology. This ordinary commercial data-licensing matter presents no special-situation or deal-risk-arb angle.
